ios.desc:
It's a todo list crossed with a game to help your family get ready for school without all the chaos. 

Enjoy your family mornings. Peaceful, happy and calm.

THE PROBLEM

Getting kids ready for school is the worst part of the day. 

Why do you feel like you've run a marathon by 9AM? Kids want to do the right thing (well, most of the time). But they forget easily and get distracted. So to push them out the door on time you have to nag, scold and argue. Until the whole morning is just a crazy-making mess.

BENEFITS OF SCHOOL MORNING ROUTINE

- You won’t have to remind them to get ready over and over (and over) 
- You’ll teach your kids independence and organisational skills.
- They’ll get ready much more quickly
- You won’t be late and you’ll give your kids more time for homework and play.
- It takes away the stress and negativity
- You’ll start your day happy and calm.

HOW IT WORKS

It’s like a to-do list combined with a game. Kids love it. And when they finish their jobs, the app rewards them with a short cat video. Because kids love cat videos. Everyone does.

Don’t waste your mornings nagging. Start the day with calm and energy, knowing you’ve done the best for your family. 

Enjoy these golden days.

OUR STORY

My name is Chris Nielsen and I live in Perth Australia with my gorgeous wife Meg and our three beautiful kids.

I got the idea for the app one day after a particularly chaotic morning getting all three kids off to school. As I arrived at work and walked through the front door of my office I thought: 

“I’m honestly as tired as if I’d just run a marathon.” 

The more I thought about it, the more it didn’t seem right that mornings should be so hard. Kids want to do the right thing (well, most of the time). But the problem is that they forget easily and get distracted. So to push them out the door on time you have to nag, scold and argue. 

I didn’t want to waste these golden days with our kids.

So Meg and I started trying different ways to help our kids get ready for school. We scoured the internet and parenting books for ideas and tried everything. Some things worked and some didn't. The more we learned, the more we realized that nothing existed that got it quite right.  So we started this app. We’ve spent a lot of time tweaking and improving the user experience and we think it’s amazing. 

Now our mornings are relaxed and peaceful. In a small, but very real way, this app has changed our lives. I hope it will help you and your family as well.

I

quotes.text:
If this is the app: 
https://apps.apple.com/ch/app/school-morning-routine/id1606853166?l=en

The I notice quite few things:
- low fps animations
- delay until the keyboard popups
- no support to save the password or use e.g. an Apple account to login
- no scrollbars in the modal and the back button out of view

So in general, this would not make the cut for the native apps my employer produces. Especially the low fps is a deal breaker.

Tested on an iPhone XR
quotes.story_title: I replaced my native iOS app with a cross platform web app and no-one noticed
